translationResources.title: Box plot
translationResources.description: Medians, quartiles, whiskers and outliers to compare distributions, from raw samples or computed statistics. Outliers are rings of the series color: hover one to read its value and group.

services.title: Response time per service
services.description: groups takes the raw samples of every box: the quartiles, the whiskers (1.5 interquartile ranges) and the outliers are computed; tooltip.labels translates the rows of the tooltip.

horizontal.title: Horizontal
horizontal.description: Statistics already computed (one datum with low, q1, y as the median, q3, high and outliers per box) in rows with orientation: "horizontal".

grouped.title: Grouped
grouped.description: boxplotData turns samples into box plot data: one series per period, the boxes of each city side by side.

temperatures.title: With a line
temperatures.description: boxplotStats gives the five numbers and the mean of each month: whisker: "minmax" extends the whiskers to the extremes and a line joins the means.

build-times.title: Whisker rules
build-times.description: CI build durations per pipeline. whisker sets how far the whiskers reach (1.5 or 3 interquartile ranges, or "minmax" for no outliers), and outlierShape and outlierSize change how the slow runs are drawn; boxplotStats with the same rule counts them.

wait-times.title: Click a box or an outlier
wait-times.description: Emergency room waits per weekday. onPointClick receives the median, q1, q3 and the number of outliers of the clicked box, or the value of the clicked outlier in item.outlier; on the category axis, event.x is the index of the day.

asset-sizes.title: Log scale
asset-sizes.description: File sizes from a few kilobytes to tens of megabytes: yAxis.type: "log" keeps every box readable, while on a linear axis the small files are crushed against zero. The format switches from kB to MB and a line marks the size budget.

live-regions.title: Live latency per region
live-regions.description: Every second a setInterval (cleared on pause and unmount) slides a window over the latest requests of each region. The color of a group turns red when its third quartile exceeds the SLA line, and the y axis range is fixed so the boxes stay comparable.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Raw response times per service: the quartiles, whiskers and outliers are computed; the tooltip rows are written in the language of locale.

BoxPlotChartProps.series: Series of box plots: points with low, q1, y (the median), q3, high and outliers (see boxplotData / boxplotStats)
BoxPlotChartProps.groups: Raw samples, one box each (an alternative to series)
BoxPlotChartProps.name: Name of the series built from groups
BoxPlotChartProps.orientation: "horizontal" lays the boxes out in rows
BoxPlotChartProps.outlierShape: Outliers drawn as rings of the series color (hollow) or as filled dots; series may set their own outlierShape
BoxPlotChartProps.outlierSize: Diameter of the outliers in CSS pixels

BoxplotGroup.values: Raw values: their quartiles, whiskers and outliers are computed
BoxplotGroup.color: Color of the box (any CSS color)

BoxplotStats.low: Lower whisker: the smallest value within reach
BoxplotStats.high: Upper whisker: the largest value within reach

BoxplotStatsOptions.whisker: Reach of the whiskers in interquartile ranges beyond the box (Tukey: 1.5); "minmax" extends them to the extremes (no outliers)

ChartTooltipLabels.open: Name of the opening price row (candlesticks)
ChartTooltipLabels.high: Name of the highest price row (candlesticks)
ChartTooltipLabels.low: Name of the lowest price row (candlesticks)
ChartTooltipLabels.close: Name of the closing price row (candlesticks)
ChartTooltipLabels.max: Name of the upper whisker row (box plots)
ChartTooltipLabels.q3: Name of the third quartile row
ChartTooltipLabels.q1: Name of the first quartile row
ChartTooltipLabels.min: Name of the lower whisker row (box plots)
ChartTooltipLabels.outliers: Name of the number of outliers
ChartTooltipLabels.value: Name of the value of bubbles when the series has no valueName
